test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the following letter, number, symbol series and answer the question.

(Left) N & 2 G 9 S P T B 4 @ H # 1 8 S B A 3 P (Right)

If all numbers are dropped from the series, which of the following will be seventh from the right?
solution:
Given series:

(Left) N & 2 G 9 S P T B 4 @ H # 1 8 S B A 3 P (Right)

After dropping all numbers from the series 

(Left) N & G S P T B @ H # S B A P(Right)

The element which is seventh from the right is:

(Left) N & G S P T B **@ **H # S B A P(Right)

Therefore after dropping all the numbers, **@ **symbol** **is seventh from the right.

Hence, the correct answer is "**@**"**.**
